empty_program: Your workspace is empty! Start by dragging a few 'move forward' cards onto the canvas.
unbalanced_block: Looks like you opened an 'if wall ahead' block but forgot the 'end if' card. Every if needs its own end if right after the cards inside it - and if you used 'else', that goes in between the two.
infinite_loop: Your program is stuck looping! If you used a while block, make sure its condition can eventually become true.
no_condition_used: This level has a turn in the road - your program needs to sense the wall and react to it. Try adding an 'if wall ahead' block to check before you keep going straight.
missing_turn: You're checking for the wall - nice! But once you find it, you still need to actually turn. Add a 'turn right' (or 'turn left') card inside your if block.
